access_links.label: Resource landing page and file inventory

description: The release contains dated municipal incident reports categorized by intervention area and issue type, including roads/signage, urban hygiene and public lighting. It provides parish and geographic-subsection identifiers with subsection coordinates. The ILU catalogue links these observations as used input to contextual transport modelling; coordinates are subsection references and are not assumed to locate each defect precisely. Native publication metadata date the collection to 2018/2019, while the metadata catalogue lists 2017–2025. That discrepancy prevents a verified exact coverage range without reading the underlying data. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened. The registered used relationship establishes inputs for demand forecasting.
